title: Drupal API documentation is version-aware
summary: Drupal API guidance must preserve Drupal version context because each Drupal version introduces APIs and keeps only some APIs from previous major versions.

drupal_core.notes: This is a versioning principle, not a timeless API fact.

actions: Attach explicit Drupal core version applicability to each knowledge record.
checks: Reject records that model Drupal API behavior as timeless when version evidence is required.
evidence_requirements: Source locator with branch or version context
Project profile Drupal core version when applying to a project
automation_hints: Resolvers should return unknown applicability rather than false when the project Drupal version is missing.

enforcement.rationale: The rule guides selection behavior; blocking requires a reviewed downstream requirement.
